formula: Do: an imperative verb, the element (a component name where one fits), and a var(--…) or step where one fits
Don't: start with 'Do not', the tempting mistake, then ' — ' and why
rules: exactly one bullet per supplied intent, in order

occasion.dos: show the firing date on every booking card
occasion.donts: use glaze photos as section backgrounds

dos: Print the firing date in title3 on every Kiln slot card, above its main action.
donts: Do not run glaze photos behind section text — the texture breaks the contrast the theme relies on.
